raw_text: بھارتی فوج نے پونچ سیکٹر میں بلااشتعال فائرنگ کی جو جنگ بندی معاہدے کی خلاف ورزی ہے۔ Pakistan Army spokesperson stated that Indian forces initiated unprovoked firing in Poonch sector, violating the ceasefire understanding. Pakistan Army responded effectively. Civilian areas on the Pakistani side reportedly affected. ISPR monitoring the situation.
clean_text: Pakistan claims Indian forces initiated unprovoked firing in Poonch sector. Pakistan Army says it responded effectively. ISPR monitoring the situation.
